DEFAULT_SETTINGS supplies persisted defaults; loadSettings merges raw data over those defaults and migrates legacy reportingCurrency/defaultCurrency to operatingCurrency.
The BQL runner invokes the configured command with -q, -f, query file path, and query arguments; it enforces a 50 MiB max buffer and rejects stderr.
PriceService executes bean-price against the resolved main ledger with a 60 second wrapper, extracts simple price directives, and deduplicates exact lines before writing prices.beancount.
